content: MYT1, or Myelin Transcription Factor 1, is a protein in humans that is encoded by the MYT1 gene. The protein encoded by the MYT1 gene belongs to a family of neural-specific proteins that contain zinc finger domains, which are DNA-binding motifs. This protein specifically binds to the promoter regions of proteolipid proteins in the central nervous system. It plays a critical role in the development of the nervous system. MYT1 has been demonstrated to interact with the protein PIN1.
